description: This file defines the 'HomePage' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to database table columns. It models data related to the homepage configuration, including properties such as action, enable class, priority, and associated user role.

classes.name: HomePage
classes.description: An entity class representing the home page configuration with properties for id, action, enableClass, priority, and userRole, along with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the HomePage entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the HomePage entity.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action associated with the home page.
